Totally fun game to play, especially with friends. If you're planning on doing a single player run through it will prove difficult and nearly impossible. This game really holds up as the first in its series and Valve has put effort into this game which I can also appreciate as its free. If you are planning to play this game it is important to have friends who also have it as there are no active online servers.

TL:DR: Best played with friends. Good attention to detail. No active online public servers.

Looks like I never reviewed this game. Here it goes:

I loved the original game (on unreal), the lore, the story, everything. and followed BlackCatGames for years, waiting and waiting for the sequel. Then, Valve bought them. Updates stopped flowing with a promise that one day, Alien Swarm: Infested would be released. I believe it was another 3 years until it finally came. It is pretty obvious the reason Valve released this game for free the way they did, was to get the Source SDK out there with a moddable client, without a buy-in from one of their other games, to try and re-vitalize the modding community momentum that once brought them to their fame and glory and powerhouse they are today, back on the gold source engine.

Regardless of the behind-the-scenes, when it was finally released, I fell in love with this game all over again, the lore, the story. everything. Sadly, they only ever released a short campaign. Letting the potential for a pay-by-episodes DLC store die through neglect in hopes that the community would pick up the slack. The community tried, but there is no way for us fans to truly capture the vision BlackCat had for this universe and franchise.

Alien Swarm on Source is probably the last there will ever be in the franchise, and the game is pretty much dead (unless you have friends to play with in CO-OP, which I highly recommend for some quick fun on LAN). But the game series is pretty much dead for solo-players. RIP.

[h1] ▀▄▀▄▀▄ Alien Swarm ▄▀▄▀▄▀ [/h1]

Alien Swarm is a top-down shooter that was release by Valve nearly a decade ago as a free game for encouraging people to mod and use the source engine (I think, this was years ago mind you.) Anyway, it still plays and looks great. It's akin to Left 4 Dead in that you're always on the move to your next objective. That objective could be holding out as waves of aliens come down on your team, destroying alien eggs from air ducts, or just trying not to get eaten alive by the various creatures you'll encounter. 

This review is more for posterity than anything else, while the multiplayer is completely functional, I'm not sure why you would elect to play this. Valve hasn't updated this in years and more to the point, there is a updated version called Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop that still receives community updates. This does get a thumbs up, but maybe play this if you're curious as to what the game used to be before Reactive Drop.

You can check out and install Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop from the Steam store [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/563560/Alien_Swarm_Reactive_Drop/] here.[/url]
